verdict.rationale: The Projects API docs name two credential types for API access: a personal access token (classic) or a GitHub App installation access token. An App token is a natural credential to give an agent, but the pack never describes scoping or least-privilege controls. Missing for 10: documentation of permission scopes or fine-grained limits for these tokens, project-level restriction of credentials, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: The token can be a personal access token (classic) for a user or an installation access token for a GitHub App.
